chalisa.do1: I bow to Mother Śākambharī, holding the Guru's feet in meditation,
and set forth the Chālīsā of Mother Śākambharī.
chalisa.do2: The blissful Jagadambikā is a storehouse of endless forms;
may Mother Śākambharī's grace remain at all times.
chalisa.cau1: Mother Śākambharī gives great joy; she is the complete Brahman, ever the remover of sorrow.
chalisa.cau2: She is the cause, the doer and the giver of the world; she is bliss and consciousness, the creator of the universe.
chalisa.cau3: Mother, your flame is undying; you alone are ever the benefactor of your devotees.
chalisa.cau4: Aparṇā, your glory is boundless and fathomless; Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Śiva are devoted to you, Mother.
chalisa.cau5: You are a mass of knowledge, merciful to the humble; you fill the homes of those who come for refuge with well-being.
chalisa.cau6: Nārāyaṇī, you make Brahman shine forth; in water, on land and in the sky you are imperishable.
chalisa.cau7: You have the radiance of the lotus and a peace beyond compare; you are full of light, dignity itself, light in form.
chalisa.cau8: Whenever devotees have meditated on you, your flame has come forth of itself.
chalisa.cau9: You are enthroned with your dear sister; Mother Śatākṣī is adorned beside you.
chalisa.cau10: Bhīmā, terrible, of fearsome form: the flame of the third sister is wondrous.
chalisa.cau11: Your fourth sister is Bhrāmarī, wondrous and nimble, who captivates the mind.
chalisa.cau12: Before you stands the hero Bhairava, who has fought hard against the hosts of demons.
chalisa.cau13: Śiva Śaṅkara, the Lord, the simple-hearted keeper of the storehouse, is ever Mother Śākambharī's servant.
chalisa.cau14: Hanumān stands resplendent with a flag in his hand; on the battlefield he is arrayed beside the Mother.
chalisa.cau15: Kālarātri, who bears a fearsome form, is the Mother's most terrible sister.
chalisa.cau16: The ten Mahāvidyās, the nine Durgās and others, and those who teach the highest truth, meditate on you.
chalisa.cau17: Gaṇapati, giver of the eight siddhis, has come in a child's form to the Mother's refuge.
chalisa.cau18: He guards the Mother's storehouse and has the right to be worshipped first.
chalisa.cau19: You are the one cause of the world's round; you are Śiva's Śakti, the destroyer of the wicked.
chalisa.cau20: There is Bhūrā Deva, and Laukaṛā the second; his is the first worship.
chalisa.cau21: Mighty Bajaraṅgī is your servant; he goes with you, singing your glory.
chalisa.cau22: Your valley stretches five kos; your divine play is very far-spread.
chalisa.cau23: It is you who became Raktadantikā; drinking blood, you slew the demons.
chalisa.cau24: You destroyed Raktabīja and took the form of Chinnamastā.
chalisa.cau25: Thousands of accomplished yoginīs shine there; you are enthroned at the seven pools.
chalisa.cau26: You took the form of a swan, and giving food again and again, you saved every soul.
chalisa.cau27: With leaves that end sorrow you saved the sages; with leaves that end sorrow you ward off the people's pain.
chalisa.cau28: As Bhadrakālī you came to Kampaleśvara; Śivā, says Kānta, gives joy to her devotees.
chalisa.cau29: Your offerings are a feast, halvā and pūrī, a flag, a coconut and a vermilion tilaka.
chalisa.cau30: A red scarf is dear to you; taking just these gifts, you take sorrow away.
chalisa.cau31: You give sight to the blind; you make a leper's body whole.
chalisa.cau32: You set children playing in the homes of childless women; you bring the poor wealth in plenty.
chalisa.cau33: Giving happiness again and again, you save the devotee; you set right the works of saints and good people.
chalisa.cau34: Your flame shines out from the earth; Mother Śākambharī destroys sorrow.
chalisa.cau35: Your smile is so very sweet; we have known you birth after birth.
chalisa.cau36: I give myself to your lotus feet; victory, victory, victory to you, mother of the world.
chalisa.cau37: Kāntā's Chālīsā gives great joy; it wards off all trouble, sorrow and indecision.
chalisa.cau38: Whoever sings the Chālīsā gains great happiness by the Mother's grace.
chalisa.cau39: Kāntāprasāda, who lives in Jagādharī, has brought to light with devotion the truth of Śākambharī.
chalisa.cau40: Again and again he says with joined hands: Śākambharī, hear my prayer.
chalisa.cau41: I am your servant, your slave; Mother, carry me across worldly existence.
chalisa.cau42: Whoever recites this a hundred times, he is worthy of the Mother's grace.
chalisa.cau43: The Mother wards off trouble and hardship; does she not destroy sorrow, delusion and the enemy?
chalisa.cau44: The poor gain wealth, happiness and riches, if they sing the Chālīsā with faith and devotion.
chalisa.cau45: Let one keep a lamp burning for the nine nights, and sing with the whole family, absorbed.
chalisa.cau46: Let one recite it with love, the mind intent; Śākambharī, says Kānta, gives great joy.
chalisa.do3: Slayer of the demon Durgama, doer of the world's works,
Mother Śākambharī, O Śivā, keep my honour.
chalisa.do4: Age after age, your vow delivers the devotee;
that one, your darling, comes to your door.
